title: Yellowish Filipino Noodles Pancit Canton
description: A garlicky, crunchy, and indulgent Filipino dish featuring Worcestershire sauce, made with mortar-pestle-pound method and ayurvedic-sattvic-friendly ingredients, in the form of pancit canton.
instructions: Heat the vegetable oil in a large wok or frying pan over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until translucent.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the sliced patola and grated carrots, and cook for 2 minutes, until they start to soften.
Add the rice flour noodles, Worcestershire sauce, soy sauce, salt, and black pepper, and stir-fry for 2 minutes, until the noodles are well coated.
Use a mortar and pestle to pound the cooked noodles for 30 seconds, to give them a slightly crushed texture.
Add the chopped green onions and stir-fry for 1 minute, until well combined.
Transfer the pancit canton to a serving platter and serve immediately.
Garnish with additional green onions and serve with a side of steamed vegetables, if desired.
